anya (Docs): Heads-up: doing a concise style pass for PR #3421. Main goals: consistent casing, clear product names, and friendlier error text. Quick votes please.

morgan (Product): Sounds good. What are the exact casing rules?

anya (Docs): Plan: REST params = param-case (kebab-case); SDKs = idiomatic (camelCase for JS, snake_case for Python, PascalCase for Go structs). Add a one-line mapping table.

rahul (Eng): OK. Telemetry/metrics remain snake_case. Also call out that internal docs can keep the term "inference"; public docs say "model serving".

kai (SDK): We'll provide example snippets for JS + Python in PR comments. Also propose a tiny note showing how request fields map between REST and SDKs.

anya (Docs): Great — I'll add docs/style/naming.md and docs/style/voice.md with examples. Error text rule: label Title Case, description sentence case and actionable. No raw internal codes in public messages.

doc-bot: PR #3421 status: needs-review.

morgan (Product): 44d on product name normalization.

anya (Docs): Action items: @kai post snippets (EOD), @rahul confirm telemetry note (tomorrow), I'll update the PR with the naming + voice files and mapping table. Merge once snippets + CI pass.
